# The Boston Globe

> 150+ years of trusted journalism covering Boston and New England news, sports, politics, and investigations.

The Boston Globe is a major regional news organization providing comprehensive coverage of Boston and New England across sports (Red Sox, Patriots, Bruins, Revolution), metro news, politics, education, weather, and investigative reporting. The site serves as the primary news source for Massachusetts residents and sports fans.

## Key Topics

- Boston sports teams
- Red Sox
- Patriots
- Bruins
- New England Revolution
- WNBA/NWSL/PWHL women's sports
- Massachusetts politics
- Boston metro news
- MBTA transportation
- Boston schools
- Weather forecasts
- Investigations
- College sports
- High school sports (MIAA)
- New England regional coverage

## Sports News

- [Boston Globe sports news - NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL scores and schedule](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports): Sports hub covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL scores, stats, and standings
- [Boston Red Sox news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/baseball/redsox): Red Sox news, scores, stats, spring training, and roster updates
- [New England Patriots news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/football/patriots): Patriots news, scores, draft coverage, and free agency updates
- [Boston Bruins news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/hockey/bruins): Bruins news, NHL scores, standings, and player updates
- [New England Revolution and Soccer - news, scores, and more](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/soccer/revolution): New England Revolution and MLS soccer news, scores, and updates
- [Women's sports news - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/women): Women's sports: WNBA, NWSL, PWHL, college hockey and soccer
- [College sports news from the Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/colleges): College sports news: hockey, basketball, NCAA tournament coverage
- [Massachusetts high school sports - MIAA news, scores, rankings from Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/high-schools): MIAA high school sports news, rankings, schedules, and scores
- [Boston sports TV listings from the Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/sports/tv-radio): Boston sports TV schedule, channels, radio stations, and broadcasts

## Boston & New England Metro News

- [Metro - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro): Boston and New England metro news: breaking news and community coverage
- [Around Massachusetts](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts): Massachusetts news coverage: regional stories from around the state
- [Cambridge & Somerville News | The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/new-england/massachusetts/cambridge-somerville): Cambridge and Somerville local news, events, and neighborhood coverage
- [Weather news and resources for Boston, Mass., and New England - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/weather): Boston and New England weather forecasts, alerts, and storm coverage
- [Politics - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/politics): Boston and Massachusetts politics, elections, and government news
- [Transportation - The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/transportation): MBTA, Logan Airport, traffic, public transit, and road updates

## Investigations & Special Coverage

- [Investigations | The Boston Globe](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/investigations): Boston Globe investigations: corruption, accountability, and scandals
- [The Great Divide - Race, class, and opportunity in Boston schools](https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/education): Boston schools investigation: inequality, budgets, and exam school admissions
